goals: Verify that the Chrome extension correctly sets custom headers and proxies requests when enabled
Verify that the extension's functionalities can be successfully toggled off and on via the popup interface
activities: Wait for the service worker target to initialize and extract the extension ID
Navigate the page to the header test URL
Verify that the page content contains the 'X-Unblock-Youku-Test' header
Navigate the page to example.com
Execute an XHR GET request to the proxy test URL and retrieve the response text
Verify that the XHR response contains 'true'
Open a new page and navigate to the extension's popup page
Click the 'off' button and wait for the extension to be disabled
Close the popup page
Navigate the page to the header test URL
Verify that the page content does not contain the 'X-Unblock-Youku-Test' header
Navigate the page to example.com
Execute an XHR GET request to the proxy test URL and retrieve the response text
Verify that the XHR response does not contain 'true'
Open a new page and navigate to the extension's popup page
Click the 'normal' button and wait for the extension to be enabled
Close the popup page
Navigate the page to the header test URL
Verify that the page content contains the 'X-Unblock-Youku-Test' header
Navigate the page to example.com
Execute an XHR GET request to the proxy test URL and retrieve the response text
Verify that the XHR response contains 'true'
